children: Selectis Health entered into a Credit Agreement for $18.23 million in secured term loans from Milrose Capital and SCG Experts to fund its tender offer and merger consideration, plus related fees. The loans carry a fixed 5.0% interest rate and mature on Aug 28, 2031, with amortization beginning Sep 1, 2027. The facility is secured by substantially all assets and can be prepaid at any time without penalty. Proceeds supported approximately $17.64 million in aggregate cash consideration for the transaction.
: Fund tender offer, merger consideration and transaction costs
